description: We're building a new single detached house on a narrow infill lot. The north side wall sits 0.3 m from the property line, which is the side yard against the neighbour's lot, not a street or lane. The client wants the same 450 mm roof overhang all the way around, including over that north wall. The soffit would be vented aluminum. Can we do this as a variance and what would we need to show?
known_facts: limiting distance 0.3 m on the north side
faces a side property line, not a public way
450 mm overhang wanted over that wall

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form
mitigation must address fire spread to the neighbour

gold.departure: Roof soffit projects over an exposing building face whose limiting distance is 0.45 m or less.

should_cite.why: protection required for soffits within 1.2 m of the property line
projection limit when the limiting distance exceeds 0.45 m

must_not_cite.prohibited_use: as the exception permitting the soffit
must_not_cite.why: the wall faces a side property line, not a public way

gold.engineering_reason: Single-family dwelling: registered professional involvement not required unless the authority invokes special safety concerns.

authoring.notes: Written from the code database only; held-out judge set not consulted.
